name: Adani Green Energy Ltd.
business_summary: India's largest renewable developer: 20,763 MW operational (H1 FY27, +24% YoY; solar, wind, hybrid), 6.6 GWh BESS, Khavda (Gujarat) world's largest single-location RE site, targeting 50 GW by FY30 under a Rs 2.4 lakh cr capex plan. Almost all capacity is on 25-year fixed-tariff PPAs (SECI, NTPC, discoms, private offtakers). Q2 FY27: revenue from power supply Rs 4,019 cr (+45%), EBITDA from power supply Rs 3,835 cr (92% margin), PAT Rs 747 cr; H1 energy sold 25.7 bn units (+32%). Net debt Rs 102,973 cr (5.6x run-rate EBITDA), avg cost 8.9%, 72% fixed. Stock Rs 1,414, mcap Rs 2.33 lakh cr, P/E 119; promoters 62.4%. Khavda evacuation delays are curtailing output.

exposures.mechanism: Longest-duration name in the batch: P/E 119, P/B 10.6, EV ~Rs 3.36 lakh cr (mcap 2.33 + net debt 1.03 lakh cr, Sep-26) so EV/MCap 1.44; cash flows are 25-yr fixed-tariff PPAs, hence terminal-value dominated. +25bp on ~9.5% WACC with equity duration ~20 => ~-5%; 28% floating debt and PPA fixed tariffs offset nothing on valuation but cap the earnings effect => -3.5. Pack: no significant US-10y beta (Fed funds -0.93, t -0.3).

exposures.mechanism: Earnings channel only. Mgmt (22 Oct): 72-73% of project loans are fixed-rate for 3-5 yrs; avg cost 8.9%. Floating ~28% x Rs 1.03 lakh cr = Rs 29k cr x 25bp = Rs 72 cr/yr vs TTM PAT Rs 2,249 cr = -3.2% PAT; capitalised to equity value via cash profit ~Rs 4.2k cr H1 => ~-0.7% of mcap; x1.44 EV/MCap persistence 1.0 => ~-1.0. Mgmt expects rating migration (BBB- to AA on operation) to cut spreads by ~50bp per notch, offsetting.

exposures.mechanism: Capex programme Rs 2.4 lakh cr to FY30 with net debt up Rs 11.7k cr in H1 alone (91,252 -> 102,973); refinancing of bridge/construction debt into bonds is continuous. +50bp on ~Rs 35k cr refinanced over 2 yrs = Rs 175 cr/yr vs cash profit ~Rs 8k cr/yr (-2.2%) plus access risk for group credits => -2.5 with persistence 0.5, EV/MCap 1.44.

exposures.mechanism: Operating 20.8 GW heading to 50 GW by FY30; Khavda curtailment cost ~Rs 300-700 cr EBITDA in H1 (EBITDA 8,276 vs ~9,000 without curtailment, call). Stronger support (PM-DHARA corridors, ISTS waiver, BESS VGF, take-or-pay protection) shortens the curtailment window and de-risks the 4.5-5 GW FY27 commissioning target. Removing H1 curtailment loss (Rs ~720 cr/6m = ~Rs 1,400 cr/yr, ~12% of TTM EBITDA) x 1.44 x persistence 0.4 => ~+7; set +6.

evidence.note: H1 EBITDA Rs 8,276 cr; ~Rs 9,000 cr without curtailment; Phase-3 evacuation now expected next quarter

exposures.mechanism: Theme drives PPA awards (SECI, FDRE, BESS, PSP) and valuation premium; AGEL has 5+ GW PSP sites and 10+ GWh BESS target FY27. +1 SSU = +10% PPA award flow assumed; growth optionality worth ~3% of mcap at 60% realisation, x EV/MCap 1.44 => ~+4.

exposures.mechanism: Mgmt cites AI/data-centre/hyperscaler demand for firm renewables and C&I contracts (AdaniConneX JV in group). +1 SSU raises share of C&I PPAs at higher tariffs (13-14% ROE target). Assumed +5% EBITDA growth runway over 3 yrs => ~+2.8.

exposures.mechanism: Almost all 20.8 GW is on 25-yr fixed-tariff, take-or-pay PPAs (curtailment compensated for PPA counterparties), so demand only matters via curtailment (less when demand is high: grid absorbs more) and merchant slice (4.7 GW tied-up, 974 MW converting; merchant until PPA starts). Peak demand 270 GW and +11% growth already in numbers; +3pp => curtailment -0.5pp of generation => +0.5% EBITDA x1.44 x ... => ~+1.2 incl. sentiment.

exposures.mechanism: Only merchant/infirm capacity is exposed (est. 5-8% of revenue; exact figure not disclosed). +15% spot => +1% revenue at ~90% margin => +1.1% EBITDA x 1.44 x persistence 0.4 => ~+0.7.

evidence.note: Out of 4.7 GW tied-up capacity, 974 MW under conversion from merchant to 25-yr fixed PPA

exposures.mechanism: Company hedged 100% of principal of foreign-currency debt (presentation note), so cash exposure is on interest and the unhedged import content of capex (modules/cells from group's Mundra plants mostly domestic, BESS cells and wind components imported). +3% INR depreciation on ~Rs 50k cr FY27 capex x ~35% imported content = Rs 525 cr, 50% not recoverable from tariffs = -0.11% mcap; hedge cost +; x 1.44 => ~-1.0, low confidence. INR 94.5 is +6.5% in 12m.

evidence.note: The company has hedged 100% of principal amount of its foreign currency debt; MTM is non-cash

exposures.mechanism: BESS is now the growth pillar (6.6 GWh installed; >10 GWh by FY27 end, 10+ GWh FTM target). +15% cell cost on ~Rs 8k cr of FY27 cell spend = Rs 1.2k cr; ~60% passes through in bids/PPA tariffs for later projects, 40% retained = Rs 480 cr = -0.2% mcap x1.44 => -0.3; widened to -0.5 for contracted-price rigidity.
